input.name: alive-before-start-and-across-documents

input.name: translate-through-the-capability

input.name: dir-and-locales
input.covers: dir() is the current pack's dir, ltr by default, ltr for a locale with no pack; locales() lists registered packs in registration order (dir defaulted, loaded) then lazy ones not yet loaded (code as name).

input.name: set-locale-unknown-warns-once

input.name: lazy-switch
input.covers: setLocale(lazy) dispatches LOAD_STARTED; the watch on loading calls the loader; its pack is registered, then the switch completes. A second setLocale replaces the previous waiter while the unchanged loading code deduplicates the loader. Once loaded, setLocale is a plain SET.

input.name: lazy-switch-superseded
input.covers: A lazy load that lands after the user switched elsewhere registers the pack but does not switch: a registered switch clears loading, and a second lazy switch replaces it (both loaders run; only the wanted one completes).

input.name: lazy-two-in-flight
input.covers: Two lazy switches in flight: both loaders run, the first to land only registers, the wanted one registers and switches.

input.name: lazy-failure
input.covers: A loader that rejects dispatches LOAD_FAILED, which clears loading when it is still the wanted code and is ignored otherwise; the code can be retried and its loader runs again.

input.name: lazy-startup-locale
input.covers: A startup locale that is a lazy pack seeds loading; the effect fetches it when the kernel starts (not before), t() shows the fallback chain until then, and the pack switches in when it lands.

input.name: lazy-startup-locale-fails
input.covers: A lazy startup pack that fails to load clears loading; the locale stays the fallback code and t() keeps the fallback chain.

input.name: lazy-resolves-immediately
input.covers: A loader whose promise is already resolved still lands a turn later: LOAD_STARTED, then REGISTER and SET within the same step.

input.name: lazy-pack-with-a-different-code
input.covers: The effect registers the pack under the code it carries and switches to that code, not the requested one.

input.name: loader-throws-in-the-watch
input.covers: A loader that throws synchronously inside the loading watch is reported by the store; loading stays set, nothing else is dispatched.

input.name: loader-throws-at-startup
input.covers: A lazy startup pack whose loader throws synchronously makes the effect throw while the kernel starts.

input.name: empty-code-loader
input.covers: A loader keyed by the empty string: LOAD_STARTED is dispatched, but the watch skips a falsy code, so nothing loads (at startup or on a switch).

input.name: register-at-runtime
input.covers: registerLocale adds a pack (it appears in locales(), and once registered its lazy loader is no longer listed); re-registering a code replaces it in place, including the current one.

input.name: register-returns-a-remover
input.covers: registerLocale returns a remover that dispatches UNREGISTER_LOCALE: the pack leaves listLocales() (a lazy loader for the code is listed again), the current locale stays but loses its pack, and a second call dispatches again and changes nothing.

input.name: add-translations-and-has-key
input.covers: addTranslations merges into a registered pack (later keys win, branches merge); an unknown code throws not-found, while strings for a lazy code wait and override its loaded pack. hasKey is true for a key in the current or fallback pack, never warns, and misses a branch without a count.

input.name: locale-events
input.covers: onLocaleChanged fires once the current locale changed and is usable (a registered switch at once, a lazy one when its pack lands), never for the same locale. onLocaleLoadFailed carries the failure as PluginErrorInfo, and setLocale rejects operation-failed with the same info as details.
